necessary_observable_frames: (F01_AMOUNT_DIRECT OR F02_VALUE_DIRECT) AND F10_PART_OR_CONTENT_R2 AND (F06_TARGET_BEFORE_PROCESS OR independent_source_to_target_frame)

necessary_observable_frames: (F01_AMOUNT_DIRECT OR F02_VALUE_DIRECT) AND F10_PART_OR_CONTENT_R2 AND (F06_TARGET_BEFORE_PROCESS OR F07_LINE_FINAL_OR_CLOSE)

necessary_observable_frames: (F01_AMOUNT_DIRECT OR F02_VALUE_DIRECT) AND F08_HOT_R2 AND F10_PART_OR_CONTENT_R2 AND (F06_TARGET_BEFORE_PROCESS OR F07_LINE_FINAL_OR_CLOSE)

necessary_observable_frames: (F01_AMOUNT_DIRECT OR F02_VALUE_DIRECT) AND F10_PART_OR_CONTENT_R2 AND (independent_source_or_stage_frame OR F06_TARGET_BEFORE_PROCESS)

tie_policy_de: Ohne Hitze gewinnt Pflanzenauszug oder gemessene Zubereitung.
